title: Austin Airport, Water & Parks Discussions
summary:
*   Aviation took center stage with an hour-long briefing on airport operations, upcoming contracts, small contractor assistance, and cargo updates.
*   Discussions focused on the city's water and wastewater utility conservation efforts.
*   Parkland maintenance was a key topic, addressing the upkeep of Austin's green spaces.
